query:
The group decided to do a Saturday pub quiz together. Who agreed, and was there anyone whose agreement carried a meaningfully different quality than the others'?

Options:
A. Ravi
B. Cleo
C. Bex
D. Tom
context:
[1] (about=Nadia, episodic, t4 @2026-01-25T11:29:00) okay group decision: do we do the pub quiz next Saturday as a unit? Tom said Ravi basically carries that team every week and I want to witness it with my own eyes 👀👀
[2] (about=Nadia, episodic, t4 @2026-01-25T11:33:00) perfect that is settled then! saturday night quiz, everyone in 🎉
[3] (about=Cleo, episodic, t4 @2026-01-25T11:32:00) i'm not great at quizzes but i'll come and draw on the answer sheet probably
[4] (about=Ravi, episodic, t6 @2026-02-01T11:37:00) It was genuinely useful to have her. I was wrong about the format being incompatible with the full group.
[5] (about=Tom, episodic, t6 @2026-02-01T11:38:00) Ravi won the tie-breaker. Knew the exact year the Pompidou opened. I didn't know he knew that.
[6] (about=Ravi, episodic, t12 @2026-02-22T11:04:00) It is a quiz. I like quizzes. I do not see why this requires analysis.
[7] (about=Tom, episodic, t12 @2026-02-22T11:05:00) It requires analysis because four years is a long time to like a quiz.
[8] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-02-22T11:03:00) Tom told me last Tuesday that Ravi has been showing up to the pub quiz every single week since Ravi moved out and has never once cancelled. That is four years of showing up. Does Ravi know Tom has noticed this? 🥺
[9] (about=Ravi, episodic, t2 @2026-01-18T11:04:00) Tom and I have a standing Tuesday quiz. He turned up last week barely able to sit down from a hill session and still managed to beat me on the science round. I chose not to acknowledge this at the time.
[10] (about=Ravi, episodic, t10 @2026-02-15T11:30:00) Same time next week. And someone book Cleo a proper celebration dinner rather than just brunch.
agent_answer:
Based on the conversation, the people who agreed to the Saturday pub quiz as a group were:

- **Tom** – he wanted to do it, specifically to see Ravi in action.
- **Cleo** – she explicitly said she would come, though she downplayed her quiz skills.
- **Ravi** – he participated, but his agreement had a **meaningfully different quality**: he later admitted he had been wrong that the quiz format was incompatible with the full group. So he was initially skeptical/reluctant, unlike the others’ enthusiasm.

**Bex** is not mentioned in the material, so there is no evidence that Bex agreed.
